translation: Gomme Selome morwa wa Yabeše a hirišana le ba bangwe kgahlanong <le yena>, a mo šwafa ka maatla lefatšeng <la batho ba babeli>, a mo bolaya, a hloma borena <la Isiraele>. Lefase la Judaea le ile la loka ka katleho, gomme ba ba neng ba le gona ba loka, gomme borena bo ile bwa hloma ka menate.
